text: Stall. I saw a lot of people stopping at our stall.
Beads. I watched her choose the beads one by one.
Thread. I heard the thread snap in the middle of the knot!
Knot. Can you see me tying the last knot?
Handmade. Every bracelet on our table is handmade.
Browse. I noticed a boy browsing for ten minutes.
Customer. I saw our first customer come back for another one.
Pattern. I watched her copy the pattern from a video.
Did you see our math teacher buy three bracelets?
Yes! I saw him choosing for ages. He looked at every pattern.
And I heard him say they were for his daughters.
That's so sweet. Did you notice the girl in the green jacket?
The one browsing for twenty minutes? I watched her try on almost every bracelet.
She didn't buy anything, but she asked me to teach her the knot.
Have you ever taught anyone before?
Never! But I've watched you do it a hundred times, so I'll try.
I saw her buy three bracelets.
I saw her looking at the beads.
I heard people laughing at the next stall.
I watched my friend tie the last knot.
Every bracelet on our table is handmade.

Sophia, it's Ruby! I'm at the fair, at our stall, and you won't believe it. Ten minutes ago, I saw a teacher stop, look at every bracelet, and buy three! Right now I can hear people laughing at the next stall, and I can see a little boy browsing our table. He has touched every pattern. Oh, and I watched a girl try on the pink one. She loved it! Please come quickly. We need more beads!
